objectives: falsify or strengthen one bounded canonical Garden mechanism
falsify or strengthen one bounded executable repository mechanism
separate specification defect from implementation gap and coverage limitation
return a concrete regression test or falsifier when proposing a change
notes: The zero-cost hourly board may use up to six OpenRouter calls: three blind independent :free-family reviews followed, only after quorum, by up to three same-family peer cross-examinations.
Execution budget and semantic-admission quorum are distinct: failed, malformed, stale, mismatched or non-zero-cost calls never count toward the >=3-family admission requirement.
Runtime selections and receipts are generated under agents/runtime or agents/outbox and are not canonical Garden design artifacts.
